ownerLock.title: This view is for the team owner.
ownerLock.body: The full project task board is owner-only. Your assigned tasks live in your inbox.

error.title: Couldn't load your tasks
error.desc: The board didn't come back from the server. Check your connection and try again.

empty.overdueClear: nothing slipping — you're on top of it

proof.hint: Recgon couldn't auto-verify this. Drop a note, paste a link, or attach a file as evidence.
proof.foot: Recgon will fetch any URL you paste and judge the page itself — not just your description.

toast.declinedOwner: declined — sent to team owner to decide
toast.filesAttached: {count, plural, one {# file attached} other {# files attached}}
toast.proofMissing: add a note, a link, or a file before submitting

triage.no_clear_fit: Recgon couldn't find a teammate whose skills match this task well enough, so it's waiting for you to decide.
triage.no_grounded_reason: A teammate matched on paper, but Recgon couldn't justify the pick from their recent work — so it held off rather than guess.
triage.no_capacity_in_window: The right people for this are fully booked for the next few weeks, so it's parked until capacity opens up.
triage.no_capacity_high_priority: This is high priority but everyone qualified is booked right now — it needs your call instead of waiting in line.

newTask.title: New task
newTask.subtitle: Recgon assigns it to the best-fit teammate, or holds it for your decision.

fields.title: title
fields.deadlineHint: optional — leave empty if there is no hard date

toast.queued: Created — Recgon will assign it on the next run

thread.heading: Thread
thread.empty: No activity yet — be the first to comment.
thread.placeholder: Write a comment… use @name to mention someone
thread.sendFailed: Couldn't post the comment — try again
thread.aiNote: Recgon reads this thread when it reframes, assigns, and verifies this task.

events.triaged: Recgon parked it for a decision
events.deferred: Recgon deferred it to a later window

editTask.title: Edit task
editTask.reframeNote: Changing the description makes Recgon rewrite the personalized version for the assignee.

createTask.title: New task
createTask.autoSchedule: Leave empty to let Recgon schedule it
